title: General coefficient-category amplitude criterion for bounded-below upper shriek
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category, let f : X \to Y admit a compactification, and suppose Rf_! is a left adjoint. If an integer N satisfies: for every integer m and every L in D(X_et,A), L in D^{\le m} implies Rf_! L in D^{\le m+N}, then the chosen right adjoint Rf^! preserves globally bounded-below objects.

source.place: isGE_iff_orthogonal, lines 617-621; source-module bounded-below docstring adjunction argument

proof.text: Choose n with K in D^{≥n} for a bounded-below K. For every L in D^{≤n-N-1}, the amplitude hypothesis gives Rf_! L in D^{≤n-1}; t-structure orthogonality and the additive adjunction imply every map L → Rf^! K is zero.
Apply TStructure.isGE_iff_orthogonal at n-N-1 and n-N to obtain Rf^! K in D^{≥n-N}; this constructs the plus_rightDerivedUpperShriek_obj field.
